name: A_REQUEST_RESET
description: Queue an IAM force-password-reset request for a resolved account. Input: account_owner (from A_RESOLVE_ACCOUNT_OWNER). Stub-safe: with no IAM creds it records a canned queued request (the demo stand-in for an IdP/IAM provisioning call) — it does NOT perform a reset. It does not itself gate anything; placing a gate: before it (so a human approves the reset) is a pipeline-authoring convention the composer follows, not a precondition this block enforces. Unknown owner ({ known: false } or empty account) yields { status: "skipped" }, never an error.
